review_type: fresh independent bounded design review, no implementation edits

evidence.fact: SampleCache immediately mkdir/load under Path(expanduser(cache_dir))/model_name/config hash; model_dump hash includes public cache_dir and model_name, without checkpoint weight bytes; cached supports None after construction only.
Public ModelConfig cache_dir inherited by TransformersModelConfig; no response cache disable field in inspected config.
Public TransformersModelConfig and constructor construct SampleCache before return; model/tokenizer loaded via ordinary configured references.
Pipeline unconditionally initializes model._cache registry; private postconstructor disable would not be sound.
Current export branch and configured fallback branch are separable; output context lives through evaluate/get_results; public cache_dir forwarding and fallback ownership fit existing contexts.
Python 3.13 TemporaryDirectory strict cleanup retries PermissionError by resetting owned path/parent permissions, including nested read-only trees.
Observed weights hashes differ A to B, all five real task caches persist, second run logs 9/9 generative and 6/6 logprob cached, scores remain 2/3 and guarded probe raises stale-response assertion.
Dependency command evidence shows syncing uv run without extra retains Lighteval 0.13 but replaces xxhash 3.8.1 with incompatible 4.0.1; extra restores 3.8.1.

rationale: Independent full copy confines absolute-path cache creation and any artifact writes to owned storage. Same-directory identity dedup, default symlink dereference, owner write/search on copied model root, strict context cleanup and public per-run cache_dir close the reproduced stale-response defect without private APIs or a new loader framework. Current-model export retains its existing single materialization. Source immutability and rare-fallback copy cost are explicit.
implementation_gates: Acceptance authorizes implementing the bounded design only. LC1-LC7, current-model export regression, actual read-only/partial-copy/nested cleanup, raw source-bound red/green and independent code review remain required; this report is neither implementation acceptance nor runtime qualification.
limits: Stable sources during copy are assumed and concurrent checkpoint publication/GPU/distributed qualification are not claimed. Broken or cyclic links fail explicitly; no guessed pruning of copied stale cache artifacts. No reviewed source files were modified.
